typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	Fact_TotalTime as string (),
	G_Dw_Run_Key as integer ()
}

source(output(
		Total_OOO as string,
		dw_agg_key as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select dw_agg_key , convert(varchar,(OutDatetime - indatetime),108) as Total_OOO from agg_fact where dw_run_key= ?',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		Total_OOO as string,
		dw_agg_key as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		Total_OOO = Param_0,
		dw_agg_key = Param_1)) ~> OLEDBCommand1
